title: perf: one touch to a11y research paths starts 9+ workflows; fold them into one job per trigger set
problem: A yaml scan of pull_request paths shows portfolio/research/a11y-evidence-record/** triggers 9 workflows and portfolio/pipeline/probes/eaa-wcag-triage/** triggers 8, each paying runner start-up and a checkout for a few seconds of work. These are the largest shared-path fan-outs in the trigger map; unscoped guards are only 2 workflows.
evidence: python3 yaml scan of .github/workflows/*.yml pull_request.paths, 2026-10-30: a11y-evidence-record/** 9 workflows, eaa-wcag-triage/** 8, a11y-own-sites/** 3, ventures/**/*.html 4
same scan: 2 of 134 workflows have no pull_request paths filter (6 jobs)
change: List the workflows behind each of the two top paths, fold those with the same checkout and runtime into one workflow with a job per tool (or one job, one step each), keep every script and failure message, check required status names first, then re-run the scan and ci_profile.py.
metric: workflows triggered by a change under portfolio/research/a11y-evidence-record/**
result: helped: yaml scan of pull_request paths on 2026-11-01 (prefix match, so an upper bound) finds 2 workflows for portfolio/research/a11y-evidence-record/** (baseline 9) and 5 for eaa-wcag-triage/** (baseline 8); workflow files 134 -> 128.

history.note: Folded nine a11y-*-ci workflows into a11y-research-ci.yml (one job, a step per suite, if !cancelled so every red suite shows). All 20 steps pass locally. Path a11y-evidence-record/** now triggers 1 workflow (was 9); eaa-wcag-triage/** 2 (was 8; eaa-wcag-triage-ci kept separate, it needs pytest).
